notes: both … and is given to the preposition עַל, which is the morpheme joining the two nouns; no waw stands in that clause.
The competing reading — עַל taking only and, with both marked added under rule 42 — is defensible but disfavoured, since עַל licenses the connective relation the correlative pair expresses.
The italic and before brought is added on rule 42's reasoning; even at t029 is the waw's, since a waw is present in that clause and rule 16's appositional even does not apply.
